title: The Casual remark at dinner
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读

meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：casual　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 casual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the headmaster wrote of ① a casual remark at dinner in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② more casual than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the casual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most casual remark at dinner anybody in the school had ever seen, or so the record for October 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too casual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the casual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a casual job for the summer, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as casual as the job for the summer they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was casual or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something casual, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite casual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the casual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, before dawn, she wrote of another casual remark at dinner in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more casual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most casual job for the summer in the whole school, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the casual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 随意（前置定语 a casual remark at dinner：1955 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件随意的闲话）
B. adj. 随意／临时（比较级 more casual than：文中两处，一处比饭桌上的闲话，一处比预想）
C. adj. 随意／临时（最高级 the most casual：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 随意（表语 too casual to do：母亲觉得它太随意，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 临时（前置定语 a casual job for the summer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩临时的零活）
F. adj. 临时（同级比较 as casual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩夏天的零活相比）
G. adj. 临时（后置定语 something casual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 临时（受程度副词修饰 quite casual：那位学生的评价）

answers.why: casual 意为“随意”，1955 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件随意的闲话”，此处作前置定语 a casual remark at dinner。
casual 意为“随意”，此处用比较级 more casual than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
casual 意为“随意”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说它是学堂里最随意的一件，故用最高级 the most casual remark at dinner。
casual 意为“随意”，母亲认为这件东西“太随意了，谁也用不上”，too casual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
casual 意为“临时”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩临时的零活”，此处作前置定语 a casual job for the summer。
casual 意为“临时”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩夏天的零活一样临时”，同级比较用 as casual as。
casual 意为“临时”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“临时的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something casual。
casual 意为“临时”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当临时”，quite 修饰原级 casual。
casual 意为“临时”，1965 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要临时”，故用比较级 more casual than。
casual 意为“临时”，母亲 1967 年说的是“整个学堂里最临时的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most casual job for the summer。

人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更随意。（more casual than …）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1955 the headmaster wrote of a casual remark at dinner in the record, and nobody forgot it.
